SELECT substr("Custom SQL Query"."order_date", 1, 7) || '-01' AS "tmn:order_date:ok", SUM("Custom SQL Query"."face_value") AS "sum:face_value:ok", SUM("Custom SQL Query"."service_fee" + "Custom SQL Query"."facility_fee" + "Custom SQL Query"."demand_fee" + "Custom SQL Query"."order_fees_allocated") AS "sum:fees:ok"
FROM (
SELECT t.ticket_id, t.order_id, t.event_id, e.event_name, e.event_date, e.status AS event_status,
       v.venue_name, v.venue_type, o.order_ts, substr(o.order_ts, 1, 10) AS order_date,
       lower(replace(o.channel, ' ', '_')) AS channel, t.tier, t.is_comp,
       t.face_value, t.service_fee, t.facility_fee, t.demand_fee,
       (o.order_processing_fee + o.delivery_fee) * 1.0 / n.tickets_in_order AS order_fees_allocated
FROM tix.tickets t
JOIN tix.orders o ON o.order_id = t.order_id
JOIN tix.events e ON e.event_id = t.event_id
JOIN tix.venues v ON v.venue_id = e.venue_id
JOIN (SELECT order_id, COUNT(*) AS tickets_in_order FROM tix.tickets GROUP BY order_id) n
  ON n.order_id = t.order_id
WHERE t.ticket_type = 'primary'
  AND o.status <> 'chargeback'
  AND v.venue_type <> 'test'
) "Custom SQL Query"
GROUP BY 1

SELECT "Custom SQL Query"."event_name" AS "none:event_name:nk", SUM("Custom SQL Query"."tickets_issued") AS "sum:tickets_issued:ok", SUM("Custom SQL Query"."capacity") AS "sum:capacity:ok"
FROM (
SELECT e.event_id, e.event_name, e.event_date, e.status, v.venue_name, v.venue_type, e.capacity,
       COUNT(t.ticket_id) AS tickets_issued, COALESCE(SUM(t.is_comp), 0) AS comps
FROM tix.events e
JOIN tix.venues v ON v.venue_id = e.venue_id
LEFT JOIN tix.orders o ON o.event_id = e.event_id AND o.status <> 'chargeback'
LEFT JOIN tix.tickets t ON t.order_id = o.order_id AND t.ticket_type = 'primary'
WHERE v.venue_type <> 'test'
GROUP BY e.event_id, e.event_name, e.event_date, e.status, v.venue_name, v.venue_type, e.capacity
) "Custom SQL Query"
WHERE "Custom SQL Query"."status" = 'completed'
GROUP BY 1

JOIN tix.events e ON e.event_id = o.event_id

         substr(o.order_ts, 1, 4) || '-Q' || ((CAST(substr(o.order_ts, 6, 2) AS INTEGER) + 2) / 3) AS order_quarter,
         SUM(t.face_value) AS face,
         SUM(t.service_fee + t.facility_fee + t.demand_fee) + MAX(o.order_processing_fee + o.delivery_fee) AS fees
  FROM tix.tickets t
  JOIN tix.orders o ON o.order_id = t.order_id
  JOIN tix.events e ON e.event_id = t.event_id
  WHERE t.ticket_type = 'primary' AND o.status <> 'chargeback' AND e.venue_id <> 'V99'
    AND o.order_ts >= '2026-07-01' AND o.order_ts < '2026-10-01'
  GROUP BY o.order_id, order_quarter
)
SELECT SUM(fees) / SUM(face + fees) AS fee_share_of_total_paid
FROM paid

SELECT SUM("Custom SQL Query"."face_value") AS "sum:face_value:ok", SUM("Custom SQL Query"."service_fee") AS "sum:service_fee:ok", SUM("Custom SQL Query"."facility_fee") AS "sum:facility_fee:ok", SUM("Custom SQL Query"."demand_fee") AS "sum:demand_fee:ok", SUM("Custom SQL Query"."order_fees_allocated") AS "sum:order_fees_allocated:ok"
FROM (
SELECT t.ticket_id, t.order_id, t.event_id, e.event_name, e.event_date, e.status AS event_status,
       v.venue_name, v.venue_type, o.order_ts, substr(o.order_ts, 1, 10) AS order_date,
       lower(replace(o.channel, ' ', '_')) AS channel, t.tier, t.is_comp,
       t.face_value, t.service_fee, t.facility_fee, t.demand_fee,
       (o.order_processing_fee + o.delivery_fee) * 1.0 / n.tickets_in_order AS order_fees_allocated
FROM tix.tickets t
JOIN tix.orders o ON o.order_id = t.order_id
JOIN tix.events e ON e.event_id = t.event_id
JOIN tix.venues v ON v.venue_id = e.venue_id
JOIN (SELECT order_id, COUNT(*) AS tickets_in_order FROM tix.tickets GROUP BY order_id) n
  ON n.order_id = t.order_id
WHERE t.ticket_type = 'primary'
  AND o.status <> 'chargeback'
  AND v.venue_type <> 'test'
) "Custom SQL Query"

SELECT "Custom SQL Query"."event_name" AS "none:event_name:nk", SUM("Custom SQL Query"."tickets_issued") AS "sum:tickets_issued:ok", SUM("Custom SQL Query"."capacity") AS "sum:capacity:ok"
FROM (
SELECT e.event_id, e.event_name, e.event_date, e.status, v.venue_name, v.venue_type, e.capacity,
       COUNT(t.ticket_id) AS tickets_issued, COALESCE(SUM(t.is_comp), 0) AS comps
FROM tix.events e
JOIN tix.venues v ON v.venue_id = e.venue_id
LEFT JOIN tix.orders o ON o.event_id = e.event_id AND o.status <> 'chargeback'
LEFT JOIN tix.tickets t ON t.order_id = o.order_id AND t.ticket_type = 'primary'
WHERE v.venue_type <> 'test'
GROUP BY e.event_id, e.event_name, e.event_date, e.status, v.venue_name, v.venue_type, e.capacity
) "Custom SQL Query"
WHERE "Custom SQL Query"."status" = 'completed'
GROUP BY 1

WITH ticket_fees AS (
  SELECT t.order_id, SUM(t.face_value) AS face,
         SUM(t.service_fee + t.facility_fee + t.demand_fee) AS ticket_fees
  FROM tix.tickets t
  WHERE t.ticket_type = 'primary'
  GROUP BY t.order_id
)
SELECT substr(o.order_ts, 1, 7) AS order_month,
       SUM(f.ticket_fees + o.order_processing_fee + o.delivery_fee) / SUM(f.face) AS take_rate
FROM ticket_fees f
JOIN tix.orders o ON o.order_id = f.order_id
JOIN tix.events e ON e.event_id = o.event_id
WHERE o.status <> 'chargeback' AND e.venue_id <> 'V99'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

WITH fees AS (
  SELECT o.event_id, SUM(t.service_fee + t.demand_fee + t.seller_fee) AS amount
  FROM tix.tickets t
  JOIN tix.orders o ON o.order_id = t.order_id
  GROUP BY o.event_id
  UNION ALL
  SELECT o.event_id, SUM(o.order_processing_fee + o.delivery_fee)
  FROM tix.orders o
  GROUP BY o.event_id
  UNION ALL
  SELECT o.event_id, -SUM(r.service_fee_refunded + r.demand_fee_refunded + r.order_fees_refunded)
  FROM tix.refunds r
  JOIN tix.orders o ON o.order_id = r.order_id
  GROUP BY o.event_id
)
SELECT substr(e.event_date, 1, 7) AS event_month, SUM(f.amount) AS recognised_fee_revenue
FROM fees f
JOIN tix.events e ON e.event_id = f.event_id
WHERE e.status = 'completed' AND e.venue_id <> 'V99'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1
